key.name: lock-hotkey
key.description: The keyboard shortcut to activate the stealth lock. Default is Super+Control+L.

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: Enable diagnostics and emergency shortcuts. Emergency actions hand off to GNOME’s native lock and never dismiss the privacy screen without authentication.

key.name: debug-abort-hotkey
key.description: Shortcut to hand off to GNOME’s native lock when diagnostics are enabled. The privacy screen stays active if GNOME cannot lock.

key.name: freeze-display
key.description: Capture the entire desktop in memory and display the frozen frame. No screenshot files are written.

key.name: pause-media
key.description: Pause playing MPRIS players and resume the same player instances when the privacy screen ends. During a handoff they remain paused until GNOME unlocks.

key.name: cursor-mode
key.description: Cursor behavior while locked. Valid values: "lock-icon" (show custom lock cursor), "normal" (leave system cursor), "hidden" (hide cursor completely).

key.name: lock-cursor
key.description: Legacy setting retained for migration compatibility with older versions.

key.name: cursor-bitmap-path
key.description: Optional path to an image file to use as the lock cursor. Leave empty to use the built-in cursor.

key.name: cursor-fg-rgba
key.description: Foreground (outline/details) color for the built-in lock cursor, stored as [R, G, B, A] 0-255.

key.name: cursor-bg-rgba
key.description: Background (fill) color for the built-in lock cursor, stored as [R, G, B, A] 0-255.

key.name: auto-reset-seconds
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before the password buffer is cleared. Set to 0 to disable auto reset.

key.name: lock-type
key.description: Controls how password entry behaves while locked. "stealth" shows no UI, while "normal" shows an on-screen password prompt.

key.name: normal-prompt-follow-cursor
key.description: When enabled (Normal lock type), the password prompt follows the cursor.

key.name: normal-prompt-cursor-anchor
key.description: Where to place the prompt relative to the cursor when following it: "br" bottom-right, "tr" top-right, "tl" top-left, "bl" bottom-left.

key.name: normal-prompt-offset-x
key.description: Horizontal offset (pixels) from the cursor when following it.

key.name: normal-prompt-offset-y
key.description: Vertical offset (pixels) from the cursor when following it.

key.name: normal-prompt-monitor
key.description: Which monitor to center the password prompt on when using fixed position. Empty string means center across all monitors. Value is the monitor index (e.g. "0", "1").

key.name: normal-prompt-fixed-x
key.description: Fixed X position (pixels) for the password prompt when not following the cursor. Use -1 to center horizontally.

key.name: normal-prompt-fixed-y
key.description: Fixed Y position (pixels) for the password prompt when not following the cursor. Use -1 to center vertically.

key.name: normal-prompt-css
key.description: Optional inline CSS applied to the password prompt container when one is shown.

key.name: normal-prompt-css-saved-entries
key.description: JSON array of saved Custom CSS entries for the Normal password prompt editor. Each entry stores a name and code snippet.

key.name: normal-background-css
key.description: Optional inline CSS applied to the full-screen background actor while locked.

key.name: normal-background-css-saved-entries
key.description: JSON array of saved Custom CSS entries for the Normal background editor. Each entry stores a name and code snippet.

key.name: visual-effect-presets
key.description: JSON array of ordinary saved effect entries, each containing a name and JSON configuration in code. Starter entries are created once for fresh installations and can be edited or removed.

key.name: visual-effect-active
key.description: Name of the selected saved visual effect. Empty means no effect. Visual effects never control password input or authentication.

key.name: visual-effect-initialized
key.description: Records first-install library initialization so edited or deleted starter entries are never restored during updates.

key.name: normal-prompt-custom-js
key.description: Retired setting. Existing JavaScript is retained for export but is never executed.

key.name: normal-prompt-custom-js-saved-entries
key.summary: Normal Prompt Custom JS Saved Entries
key.description: Retired saved JavaScript library. Existing entries are retained for export but are never executed.

key.name: debug-show-info
key.description: Show session and authentication status when diagnostics are enabled. Passwords and typed characters are never displayed or logged.

key.name: debug-abort-use-lock-hotkey
key.description: Use the activation shortcut as the emergency GNOME lock shortcut while the privacy screen is active.

key.name: debug-abort-hotkey-custom
key.description: Stores the user-defined Debug Abort Hotkey when "Use Lock Hotkey for Abort" is enabled. When the option is disabled, this value is restored back to Debug Abort Hotkey.
